items.title: 〈億光法說〉車用產品線成Q2營收主要引擎 銅鑼廠Q4交割
items.title_en: EPILED’s Earnings Call: Automotive Products Drive Q2 Revenue, Copper Plant to Close in Q4
paras: LED廠億光(2393-TW)今(17)日召開法人說明會，億光受惠車用產品出貨強勁，車用業務躍居第二季營收成長的主要動能，帶動單季合併營收繳出季增6.4%的亮眼表現。與此同時，公司積極推進資產活化計畫，日前公告處分的台灣銅鑼廠預計將於今年第四季完成交割。
車用產品線成為推升整體業績向上的核心主力，應用範疇廣泛涵蓋車用背光與車載不可見光元件。其餘產品線則呈現持平或小幅變動態勢，目前不可見光產品占比約40%，消費性電子產品占25%，背光與車用產品各占13%，照明產品則占9%。
針對外界關注的銅鑼廠處分案，億光指出相關交易依照進度推進中，預估交割時間落在今年第四季。公司處分該廠主要考量為集中集團內部資源並靈活調配資產配置，藉此提升整體資產報酬率與經營效率，未來全球生產重鎮將聚焦於台灣苑裡、土城，以及中國大陸蘇州與廣東等核心基地。
億光提到，短期內除了銅鑼廠之外並無其他資產處分計畫，將持續把充裕資金與資源投注於具長期成長潛力之策略性投資。
在各產品線獲利表現方面，車用產品因包含毛利較佳的車載背光，其毛利率水準僅次於消費性電子與不可見光，表現明顯優於整體平均值。儘管第二季毛利率受到原物料成本上漲與人民幣匯率波動影響而承壓，但受惠於費用控管與業外評價利益挹注，上半年每股稅後純益仍繳出2.14元水準。
paras_en: LED manufacturer Epiled (2393‑TW) held a corporate briefing today (the 17th). The company benefited from strong shipments of automotive products, with the automotive segment becoming the main driver of second‑quarter revenue growth and delivering a robust 6.4% quarter‑over‑quarter increase in consolidated revenue. At the same time, the firm is actively advancing its asset revitalisation plan and has announced that the disposal of its Taiwan copper‑plant will be completed in the fourth quarter of this year.

The automotive product line is the core engine pushing overall performance higher, covering a wide range of applications such as vehicle backlighting and invisible‑light components for cars. The other product lines are flat or showing only minor changes; currently invisible‑light products account for about 40% of sales, consumer electronics 25%, backlighting and automotive products each 13%, and lighting products 9%.

Regarding the much‑watched copper‑plant disposal, Epiled said the transaction is proceeding on schedule and is expected to close in the fourth quarter of this year. The rationale for selling the plant is to concentrate internal group resources and flexibly re‑allocate assets, thereby improving overall asset returns and operating efficiency. Going forward, the company’s global manufacturing hubs will focus on core sites in Yuanli and Tucheng in Taiwan, as well as Suzhou and Guangdong in mainland China.

Epiled added that, aside from the copper‑plant sale, there are no other asset‑disposal plans in the short term, and it will continue to invest its ample cash and resources into strategic investments with long‑term growth potential.

In terms of profitability across product lines, automotive products—thanks to the higher‑margin vehicle backlighting—rank second only to consumer electronics and invisible‑light products in gross‑margin level, clearly outperforming the overall average. Although Q2 gross margin was pressured by rising raw‑material costs and RMB exchange‑rate fluctuations, effective cost control and non‑operating valuation gains helped the company deliver a first‑half earnings per share of NT$2.14 after tax.

items.title: 賴清德：明年在稅出平衡下每人普發現金1萬元 讓AI紅利全民共享
items.title_en: Tsai Ing-wen: Next Year, Every Person Will Receive NT$10,000 in Cash Under Tax Balance, Let AI Dividends be Shared by All
paras: 行政院於今(17)日上午第2次向總統賴清德報告明(116)年中央總預算編列情形。賴清德在聽取簡報後表示，台灣憑藉長期的半導體、資通訊等供應鏈優勢，經濟成長率上修，今(115)年可望創下39年來新高，明年總預算將在歲入歲出平衡、實質零舉債下，增列2,357億元普發現金予每人1萬元，讓「AI紅利，全民共享」。
賴清德指出，2周前，當他首次聽取「116年度總預算案」報告時，當時他就提到，明年總預算案要在財政穩健的基礎上，兼顧國家安全、經濟發展與人民照顧，也要讓經濟成長的成果由全民共享，這2周行政團隊一方面進行總預算的朝野協商；另一方面，持續進行明年度預算整編。上周五(14日)，主計總處公布最新的經濟數字也可看到，台灣的經濟表現持續上修，相較之前預測更為強韌。
賴清德表示，今年第1季經濟成長率從14.55%上修到15.43%；第2季初步統計也達到12.93%，已連3季呈現雙位數成長，上半年的經濟成長率更達到14.15%，是半世紀以來同期最強表現，今年全年經濟成長率，據主計總處最新預測，從原先的9.64%上修到11.05%，可望創下39年以來新高的紀錄。
賴清德說，這樣亮眼的數字，是全體台灣人民一起打拚的成果，雖面臨動盪的國際政經局勢，面對國內的政治紛擾，依然能夠穩健向前，交出亮眼的成績單，在AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求快速增加，台灣憑藉長期累積的半導體、資通訊及製造供應鏈優勢，相關訂單、出口及投資也持續成長，成為今年經濟強勁成長的重要動能。
然而，賴清德也強調，必須正視，經濟成長是全民共同創造，但每一個人感受到成長速度並不完全相同，AI蓬勃發展、科技業出口暢旺，是台灣的機會，但在科技業之外，還有更多國人，每一天在服務業、在傳產、在中小微企業殷勤打拚。
政府也不會只關注科技產業的高峰，因此伴隨經濟成長上修，明年總預算歲入，也上修到3兆9,266億元，在歲入歲出平衡前提下，決定增列2,357億元，用來明年普發現金，每人1萬元，全民共享。
賴清德也說，這1萬元怎麼使用，由每個人、每個家庭自己決定，可以拿來支付孩子的教育費，可以照顧長輩，可以減輕家庭負擔，也可以增加消費、支持在地店家及百工百業。但他也強調，普發現金納入整體預算後，明年度總預算仍然維持收支平衡，債務淨額沒有增加，要照顧人民眼前的需要，也對未來的世代負責，分享經濟成長的果實，也守住國家財政的紀律。
paras_en: The Executive Yuan reported to President Tsai Ing-wen on the central government's budget for next year. After listening to the report, Tsai Ing-wen stated that Taiwan's economy is expected to grow at a rate that will be the highest in 39 years, thanks to its long-term advantages in the semiconductor and ICT supply chains. The budget for next year will be balanced, with no debt increase, and an additional NT$235.7 billion will be allocated to give every person NT$10,000 in cash, allowing everyone to share in the 'AI dividend'.

Tsai Ing-wen pointed out that two weeks ago, when he first heard the report on the '2024 budget', he mentioned that the budget for next year should be based on a stable financial foundation, taking into account national security, economic development, and people's welfare, and that the results of economic growth should be shared by all. Over the past two weeks, the administrative team has been engaged in cross-party negotiations on the budget and has continued to review and revise the budget for next year.

Tsai Ing-wen stated that the economic growth rate for the first quarter of this year has been revised upward from 14.55% to 15.43%, and the preliminary statistics for the second quarter also reached 12.93%, with three consecutive quarters of double-digit growth. The economic growth rate for the first half of the year reached 14.15%, the strongest performance in half a century. According to the latest forecast by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, the annual economic growth rate is expected to be revised upward from 9.64% to 11.05%, which would be a new high in 39 years.

Tsai Ing-wen said that these impressive numbers are the result of the joint efforts of all Taiwanese people. Despite facing a turbulent international political and economic situation and domestic political turmoil, Taiwan has been able to move forward steadily and achieve remarkable results. With the rapid growth in demand for AI, high-performance computing, and cloud services, Taiwan's long-term accumulation of advantages in the semiconductor, ICT, and manufacturing supply chains has led to continuous growth in related orders, exports, and investment, which has become an important driving force for this year's strong economic growth.

However, Tsai Ing-wen also emphasized that it is necessary to recognize that economic growth is a joint creation of all people, but the speed of growth is not felt equally by everyone. The prosperity of AI and the booming export of the tech industry are opportunities for Taiwan, but outside of the tech industry, there are many more people who are working hard every day in the service industry, traditional industries, and small and medium-sized enterprises.

The government will not only focus on the high points of the tech industry. With the upward revision of economic growth, next year's total budget revenue will also be revised upward to NT$3.9266 trillion. On the premise of balancing revenue and expenditure, it has been decided to add NT$235.7 billion to distribute NT$10,000 in cash to every person next year, allowing everyone to share in the benefits.

Tsai Ing-wen also said that how the NT$10,000 is used will be decided by each individual and each family. It can be used to pay for children's education, take care of the elderly, reduce family burdens, or increase consumption and support local businesses and industries. However, he also emphasized that after the cash distribution is included in the overall budget, the total budget for next year will still maintain a balance between revenue and expenditure, and the net debt will not increase. The government needs to take care of people's immediate needs while being responsible to future generations, sharing the fruits of economic growth while maintaining the discipline of national finances.

items.title: 天能綠電拿下欣銓10年長約 搶AI半導體綠電商機
items.title_en: Tieneng Secures 10-Year Contract with Hsinchu to Supply Green Electricity to AI Semiconductor Industry
paras: 雲豹能源(6869-TW)旗下售電子公司天能綠電(7842-TW)今(17)日宣布與半導體測試大廠欣銓(3264-TW)續簽綠電轉供合作，雙方此次簽訂10年期綠電採購合約，總轉供量達5.5億度。天能綠電將整合集團發電案場與外部合作電廠綠電資源，自明年1月起正式轉供欣銓科技使用，協助企業穩定取得綠電，加速低碳轉型。
欣銓為台灣前三大晶圓測試廠，已於2023年正式加入全球再生能源倡議組織RE100，並於2026年通過科學基礎減量目標倡議(Science Based Targets initiative, SBTi)近期減碳目標審查。
欣銓自2023年起即與天能綠電合作綠電轉供，首期合作累計交易電量約3,900萬度。此次續簽10年綠電採購合約，總交易電量提升至5.5億度，不僅反映企業綠電需求持續升溫，也顯示長期綠電採購已逐漸成為企業能源管理的重要方向。
此外，欣銓規劃於2040年達成RE60目標，此次與天能綠電長期合作，正是欣銓實踐RE100與SBTi承諾的關鍵具體行動，將進一步提升再生能源使用比例，積極因應AI應用帶動的用電成長，以及全球供應鏈日益提升的減碳要求。
天能綠電總經理唐亞聖表示，企業採購綠電不再只是因應法規要求，而是企業永續經營與全球競爭力的重要基礎。隨著AI應用快速發展，半導體等高科技產業對穩定電力與綠電供應的需求持續提升。欣銓科技積極加入RE100與SBTi等國際倡議，並付諸長期能源規劃，展現了高科技產業在永續發展上的前瞻性與決心，這也是企業面對國際減碳推進時，強化綠色供應鏈競爭力的最佳典範。
唐亞聖表示，在AI帶動產業升級趨勢下，企業對長期、穩定綠電供應的需求將持續增加，綠電採購也將從永續管理，逐步成為強化全球綠色供應鏈競爭力的重要基礎。
根據能源署售電月報統計，天能綠電2025年綠電轉供量近4.2億度，2026年1至6月綠電交易量已達3.05億度，穩居國內民營售電業第一。未來，天能綠電將持續強化綠電交易規模與能源管理服務，協助企業建構更具韌性的低碳能源布局。
paras_en: Tieneng Renewable Energy (7842-TW), a subsidiary of Cloud Leopard Energy (6869-TW), announced on 17th that it has signed a 10-year green electricity supply agreement with Hsinchu (3264-TW), a leading semiconductor testing company. The total supply volume is 550 million kWh. Tieneng Renewable Energy will integrate its group's power generation projects with external cooperative power plants to supply green electricity to Hsinchu Technology from January next year, helping the company to stabilize its green electricity supply and accelerate its low-carbon transformation.

Hsinchu is one of Taiwan's top three wafer testing companies and has officially joined the global renewable energy advocacy organization RE100 since 2023. It has also passed the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term carbon reduction target review in 2026.

Hsinchu has been cooperating with Tieneng Renewable Energy on green electricity supply since 2023. The initial cooperation has completed a total of approximately 39 million kWh of electricity transactions. This time, the 10-year green electricity supply agreement has increased the total electricity transactions to 550 million kWh, not only reflecting the continuous warming of corporate green electricity demand but also showing that long-term green electricity procurement has become an important direction of corporate energy management.

In addition, Hsinchu plans to achieve the RE60 goal by 2040. This time, the long-term cooperation with Tieneng Renewable Energy is a key specific action to implement Hsinchu's commitment to RE100 and SBTi, which will further increase the proportion of renewable energy use, actively respond to the growth of electricity consumption driven by AI applications, and the increasing demand for carbon reduction in the global supply chain.

Tieneng Renewable Energy General Manager Tang Yasheng said that corporate green electricity procurement is no longer just a response to regulatory requirements, but an important foundation for corporate sustainable operation and global competitiveness. With the rapid development of AI applications, the high-tech industry, including semiconductors, continues to increase its demand for stable power and green electricity supply. Hsinchu Technology actively joins RE100 and SBTI international advocacy and makes long-term energy planning, showing a forward-looking and determined attitude towards sustainable development, which is also the best example of strengthening green supply chain competitiveness in the face of international carbon reduction promotion.

Tang Yasheng said that under the trend of industry upgrading driven by AI, corporate demand for long-term and stable green electricity supply will continue to increase, and green electricity procurement will gradually become an important foundation for strengthening global green supply chain competitiveness.

According to the Energy Bureau's sales report, Tieneng Renewable Energy's green electricity supply volume in 2025 was approximately 420 million kWh, and the green electricity transaction volume from January to June 2026 was 305 million kWh, ranking first in the domestic private sales industry. In the future, Tieneng Renewable Energy will continue to strengthen its green electricity trading scale and energy management services to help enterprises build a more resilient low-carbon energy layout.

items.title: 中國經濟下半年開局乏力 工業生產、消費不如預期
items.title_en: China's Economy Struggles in Second Half, Industrial Production, Consumption Disappoint
paras: 最新數據顯示，中國經濟在下半年開局乏力，工業生產、消費與投資的表現均不如預期。
中國國家統計局17日（周一）公布的數據顯示，7月工業生產較去年同期成長4.5%，為三個月來首度放緩，不如經濟學家原估；零售銷售增長0.6%，不如6月的1%，也遜於經濟學家預期。
今年前七個月城鎮固定資產投資年降6.7%，降幅大於前六個月的5.7%。7月城鎮調查失業率從5%上升到5.2%。
國家統計局表示，總的來看，1～7月國民經濟運行總體平穩，保持向新向優向好發展態勢。但也要看到，外部環境複雜多變，國內供強需弱矛盾突出，部分企業經營困難，經濟穩中向好的基礎還需鞏固。
國家統計局說，下階段，要堅持穩中求進工作總基調，完整準確全面貫徹新發展理念，加快建立新發展格局，堅持深化改革開放，加快推動新舊動能轉換，加大逆周期調節力道，擴大內需，強化供給，切實改善民生。
《彭博》指出，內需疲軟和極端天氣造成的破壞，正在拖累經濟。儘管出口強勁，第二季經濟增速仍低於政府設定的4.5%至5% 的全年目標，且彭博行業研究估計，經濟成長動能在8月初進一步減弱。
上個月強降雨和強風席捲中國大片地區，導致工廠和港口暫時關閉、電力中斷，迫使數萬人撤離。雖然這種干擾可能僅具短期影響，但政策制定者可能正在密切監測數據，以評估是否需要向經濟提供更多支持，確保實現經濟成長目標。
paras_en: China's economy got off to a slow start in the second half, with industrial production, consumption, and investment all falling short of expectations.

Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Monday showed that industrial production grew 4.5% in July compared to the same period last year, the first slowdown in three months, and less than economists had expected. Retail sales growth was 0.6%, less than the 1% seen in June and also below economists' forecasts.

Fixed asset investment in urban areas fell 6.7% in the first seven months of the year, a larger decline than the 5.7% seen in the first six months. The urban unemployment rate rose to 5.2% in July from 5%.

The National Bureau of Statistics said that overall, the national economy ran smoothly in the first seven months, maintaining a stable and favorable development trend. However, it also noted that the external environment is complex and changing, and the contradiction between supply and demand is prominent, with some enterprises facing difficulties, and the foundation for steady and good economic growth still needs to be consolidated.

The National Bureau of Statistics said that in the next stage, it will continue to adhere to the overall tone of steady progress, fully and accurately implement the new development concept, accelerate the establishment of a new development pattern, adhere to deepening reform and opening up, accelerate the conversion of old and new kinetic energy, increase countercyclical adjustment efforts, expand domestic demand, strengthen supply, and improve people's livelihoods.

Bloomberg pointed out that weak domestic demand and extreme weather damage are dragging on the economy. Although exports are strong, the second-quarter economic growth rate is still below the government's target of 4.5% to 5% for the year, and Bloomberg industry research estimates that the economic growth momentum will weaken further in early August.

Last month, heavy rain and strong winds swept across large areas of China, forcing factories and ports to close temporarily, disrupting power supplies, and prompting tens of thousands of people to evacuate. Although this disruption may only have short-term effects, policymakers may be closely monitoring the data to assess whether additional support is needed to ensure the economy meets its growth targets.

items.title: 顯卡價格狂飆 但真正漲的不是GPU 而是GDDR7顯存
items.title_en: GPU Prices Soar, But the Real Driver of Cost Increases is GDDR7 Memory
paras: 8 月顯卡漲價潮愈演愈烈，RTX 5090、RTX 5080 市場價格一路走高，超AMD(AMD-US) 也宣布調漲 RX 9000 系列售價 10% 至 15%。但這波顯卡大漲，真正推高成本的主角並非 GPU，而是過去較不顯眼的GDDR7 顯存。
隨著 AI 伺服器大量搶占先進記憶體產能，記憶體大廠將資源轉向獲利更高的 HBM，排擠消費級 GDDR7 供應。
如今 RTX 5090 光是顯存成本就約占官方建議售價 16%，顯卡產業正迎來一場成本結構逆轉：過去買顯卡主要是在為 GPU 算力付費，如今愈來愈多成本，正在被顯存吃掉。
根據新浪財經 8 月 4 日數據，一顆 2GB GDDR7 顯存現貨價格已超過 20 美元，以 RTX 5090 搭載 16 顆計算，光是顯存成本就約 320 美元，約占官方建議售價 1999 美元的 16%，而且還未計入 GPU 核心、PCB、散熱與供電模組。
這意味顯卡的成本結構正出現變化，過去消費者買高階顯卡，主要是在為 GPU 算力付費，如今愈來愈高的成本正被記憶體吃掉。
AI搶產能 GDDR7成稀缺資源
顯存突然變貴，關鍵並不完全出在顯卡市場，而是記憶體大廠重新分配產能。
消費級顯卡採用的 GDDR7，與 AI 伺服器大量需求的高頻寬記憶體（HBM），都需要先進記憶體製程產能。
對三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 與美光(MU-US) 而言，相較於消費級 GDDR，將晶圓投入 HBM，再供應輝達及雲端服務業者，具有更高的獲利空間，因此三大記憶體原廠近年持續將先進產能向 HBM 傾斜。
更關鍵的是輝達本身的產品取捨。2026 年上半年輝達主動削減 30% 至 40% 的 RTX 50 系列消費級顯卡產能，將原先配置給消費市場的記憶體供應轉向獲利率更高的資料中心產品。
當上游資源持續往 AI 集中，顯卡漲價也就不只是通路囤貨炒作，而是背後供應結構發生改變。
不同於挖礦潮 AI需求更具結構性
上一輪顯卡價格失控發生在 2021 年，主要推力來自加密貨幣挖礦，需求具有高度投機性；這次則不同，背後是大型科技公司持續擴張 AI 資料中心。
微軟(MSFT-US) 、Google、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 與甲骨文(ORCL-US) 2026 年合計資本支出預估達 6600 億至 6900 億美元，相關支出已納入基礎設施建設計畫。
當 AI 伺服器持續爭搶 HBM，記憶體廠自然更有誘因將有限產能投入高毛利產品，進一步排擠消費級市場。
記憶體漲價的利益也沿著供應鏈重新分配。三星記憶體業務營收年增 471%，SK 海力士 DRAM 平均售價季增 30%；鎧俠單季淨利從 183 億日元增至 8422 億日元，宇瞻第二季淨利更年增 19.87 倍、毛利率達 51%。
上游吃紅利 終端消費者買單
產業鏈最上游的三星、SK 海力士與美光成為這輪漲價循環主要受益者，並透過把產能從低毛利消費級記憶體移向高毛利 HBM，進一步掌握產能與定價權。
夾在中間的輝達、AMD 與板卡廠，一方面享受 AI 需求成長，另一方面也面臨顯存成本攀升壓力。
技嘉 8 月 1 日將 GPU 訂單價格調高 20% 至 40%，AMD 對 RX 9000 系列調漲 10% 至 15%，都反映上游成本逐步向下游轉嫁。最後承擔價格壓力的，則是組裝電腦用戶、遊戲玩家與中小企業。
短期而言，中國本土供應鏈也難以完全填補缺口。雖然中國 AI 晶片已在政務、金融等領域逐步擴大應用，但在消費級顯卡與中小企業現貨市場，GPU 產能、軟體生態與開發者支援仍存在差距；GDDR7 與 HBM 等先進記憶體的核心供應能力，也仍主要掌握在三星、SK 海力士與美光手中。
算力瓶頸從GPU轉向記憶體
這波顯存漲價更值得注意的是，算力產業的瓶頸正在改變。隨著 GPU 運算密度持續提高，決定系統效能的不再只是晶片本身有多快，也包括記憶體能否以足夠高的頻寬，把資料即時送進運算單元。
AI 伺服器爭奪 HBM，高階顯卡需要 GDDR7，手機、PC 與遊戲主機則需要 DRAM，看似分屬不同市場，背後卻都在競逐有限的先進記憶體產能。
當原本只是物料清單（BOM）其中一環的記憶體成本快速攀升，硬體廠商的成本控制、供應鏈配置乃至產品策略，都可能因此重新調整。
換言之，這輪顯卡漲價表面看似 RTX 5090、RTX 5080 等高階產品價格失控，真正的主角卻逐漸從 GPU 轉向顯存。只要 AI 資料中心仍持續吸收先進記憶體產能，消費級顯卡面臨的供應與成本壓力就難以迅速消失。
這次顯卡漲瘋了，但真正漲得最兇的，可能不是那顆最受矚目的 GPU，而是旁邊一顆顆過去較少被消費者注意的顯存。
paras_en: The GPU price surge in August is intensifying, with the RTX 5090 and RTX 5080 market prices rising steadily, and AMD also announcing a 10% to 15% price increase for the RX 9000 series. However, the recent GPU price surge is not driven by the GPU itself, but rather by the relatively less visible GDDR7 memory.
As AI servers continue to occupy advanced memory production capacity, memory manufacturers are shifting resources to more profitable HBM, squeezing out consumer-grade GDDR7 supplies.

Today, the RTX 5090's display memory cost alone accounts for about 16% of its official recommended price, and the GPU industry is facing a cost structure reversal: in the past, consumers bought GPUs primarily to pay for their computing power, but now, more and more costs are being eaten up by memory.

According to Sina Finance data on August 4, a 2GB GDDR7 memory chip has a current market price of over $20, and with the RTX 5090 equipped with 16 cores, the display memory cost alone is approximately $320, accounting for about 16% of the official recommended price of $1,999, not including GPU cores, PCB, heat dissipation, and power modules.
This means that the cost structure of graphics cards is changing, and consumers who buy high-end graphics cards are now paying more for memory than for GPU computing power.
AI is competing for HBM, making GDDR7 a scarce resource.
The sudden increase in memory prices is not entirely due to the graphics card market, but rather the memory manufacturers' reallocation of production capacity.
Consumer-grade graphics cards use GDDR7, while AI servers require high-bandwidth memory (HBM), both of which require advanced memory production capacity.

For Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS), and Micron (MU-US), compared to consumer-grade GDDR, investing in HBM for high-margin products for companies like NVIDIA and cloud service providers offers higher profit margins, so the three major memory manufacturers have been shifting their advanced production capacity to HBM in recent years.

More importantly, NVIDIA's product selection has a significant impact. In the first half of 2026, NVIDIA actively reduced production capacity for consumer-grade RTX 50 series graphics cards by 30% to 40%, redirecting the original memory supply to more profitable data center products.
As upstream resources continue to flow towards AI, the recent GPU price surge is not just a result of channel hoarding and speculation, but rather a change in the supply structure.
Unlike the 2021 GPU price surge, which was driven by cryptocurrency mining with high speculative demand, this time the driver is the continuous expansion of AI data centers by major tech companies.

Microsoft (MSFT-US), Google, Amazon (AMZN-US), Meta (META-US), and Oracle (ORCL-US) are expected to spend a combined $66 billion to $69 billion in 2026, with related expenditures included in infrastructure development plans.
As AI servers continue to compete for HBM, memory manufacturers naturally have more incentives to invest in high-margin products, further squeezing out the consumer market.

The benefits of memory price increases are also being redistributed along the supply chain. Samsung's memory business revenue increased by 471%, SK Hynix's DRAM average selling price increased by 30% in a quarter, and Gyao's quarterly net profit increased from 183 billion yen to 8422 billion yen, while Ushin's second-quarter net profit increased by 19.87 times, with a gross margin of 51%.

The top-tier companies in the industry chain, including Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, are the main beneficiaries of this round of price increases, and they are further consolidating their control over production capacity and pricing power by shifting their production capacity from low-margin consumer-grade memory to high-margin HBM.

The companies in the middle of the supply chain, including NVIDIA, AMD, and motherboard manufacturers, are enjoying the growth of AI demand, but they are also facing the pressure of rising display memory costs.

On August 1, Gigabyte raised its GPU order prices by 20% to 40%, and AMD increased the prices of its RX 9000 series by 10% to 15%, reflecting the gradual downward transfer of upstream costs to downstream companies.

In the short term, the Chinese domestic supply chain is unlikely to fully fill the gap. Although Chinese AI chips are gradually expanding their applications in government, finance, and other fields, there are still gaps in GPU production capacity, software ecosystems, and developer support in the consumer-grade graphics card and small and medium-sized enterprise markets.
The core supply capacity for advanced memory such as GDDR7 and HBM is still mainly controlled by Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron.
This round of memory price increases is worth noting because the bottleneck in the computing industry is shifting from GPUs to memory.

As GPU computing density continues to improve, the system's performance is no longer determined solely by how fast the chip is, but also by whether the memory can provide sufficient bandwidth to deliver data to the computing unit in real-time.

AI servers are competing for HBM, high-end graphics cards need GDDR7, and smartphones, PCs, and game consoles need DRAM, which may seem like different markets, but they are all competing for limited advanced memory production capacity.

As memory costs rapidly increase, becoming a significant component of the bill of materials (BOM), hardware manufacturers' cost control, supply chain configuration, and product strategies may all be adjusted.

In other words, this round of GPU price increases may seem like a surface-level issue with high-end products like the RTX 5090 and RTX 5080, but the real driver of cost increases is actually shifting from GPUs to memory.
As long as AI data centers continue to absorb advanced memory production capacity, the supply and cost pressures faced by consumer-grade graphics cards will be difficult to quickly alleviate.
This time, the GPU prices have skyrocketed, but the real culprit may not be the most attention-grabbing GPU, but rather the relatively less visible memory.

items.title: 頂尖基金也難跑贏大盤！24大機構「選股」命中率逾半低於50%
items.title_en: Even Top Funds Struggle to Beat the Market: 24 Institutions' 'Stock Picking' Success Rate Below 50%
paras: 就算是全球頂尖的基金經理人，似乎也沒有大家想像中那麼容易「選對股票」；而且選對股票的比例高，亦不代表最後一定能打敗大盤。隨著今年第二季13F申報期限於8月14日截止，追蹤的24家大型機構持倉已全數公開，也讓市場得以檢視這批頂尖投資人究竟有多少資金押對了方向。
一項針對24家機構的持倉統計顯示，若以6月30日至8月14日、共45個交易日為觀察區間，並以同期標普500指數3.96%的漲幅作為基準，24家機構中僅少數投資人的持倉有超過一半資金配置在跑贏大盤的個股上。
其中，Viking Global與淡馬錫以66.7%的「命中率」並列第一，代表兩家機構約三分之二的持倉資金配置在同期表現優於標普500的股票。
選股命中率榜，押中跑贏標普500股票的資金占比：
值得注意的是，即使是量化投資領域的重要代表文藝復興科技，這一期間押注跑贏大盤的資金比例也僅略高於一半；而能夠擠進前10名的最低門檻，更只有48.7%。
從整體樣本來看，24家機構中有15家的命中率低於50%，中位數為44.3%。換言之，在這項特定期間與計算方式下，多數機構配置的資金中，超過一半並未跑贏標普500。
不過，單看「命中率」仍不足以衡量投資績效。
如果將24家機構的持股資金合併計算，涵蓋超過5,000檔股票、總規模逾1.2兆美元，其中52.3%的資金配置在同期跑贏大盤的股票，但這個組合的同期報酬率仍只有3.57%，低於標普500的3.96%。
這反映出，選股勝率與最終投資報酬並非同一回事。即使超過半數資金押中表現優於大盤的股票，只要押錯的部位跌幅較大，或押對的股票漲幅不足，整體績效仍可能落後指數。
對大型機構而言，投資決策也不能單純以個股漲跌判斷。管理數百億甚至上千億美元資產時，還必須考量市場流動性、資金規模及贖回等因素，與一般投資人的操作條件並不相同。
分析指出，這代表這份統計更值得注意的地方，不在於判斷哪家機構「最會選股」，而是顯示即使是全球最受關注的專業投資機構，在45個交易日的短期觀察期間，也很難讓大部分資金穩定跑贏大盤。
此外，13F本身也存在明確限制。申報資料主要反映美股多頭持倉，並未涵蓋空頭、期貨、非美股票及現金部位，因此投資人看到的只是機構投資組合的一部分。
同時，13F反映的是6月30日季末的持倉快照，最晚可至8月14日才完成申報。這代表季末至申報日之間的交易並不會立即反映在這份公開資料中，因此無法單憑13F判斷機構在這段期間是否持續持有相關股票。
另外，這24家機構屬於特定追蹤樣本，並非隨機抽樣，因此相關排名不能直接視為整體機構投資人的普遍表現。
其中，Citadel的數據也有特殊性。按照SEC申報規則，其申報內容包含自家做市業務的庫存，因此與單純以投資為主的避險基金持倉並非完全可比。
至於這份統計尚未揭露的其他面向，還包括完整24家排名、調倉與換手表現，以及專門檢視「賣出」決策的相關排名。此外，進一步將各項排名進行相關性分析後，也發現部分榜單實際上可能反映相近的投資特徵。
因此，13F提供的與其說是一份「投資大師答案卷」，不如說是一張截至特定時間點的持倉截圖。
分析人士指出，從這份資料可以觀察大型機構把資金押在哪裡，但若要判斷其真正的投資能力，仍不能只看單一季度的持倉命中率。
paras_en: Even top fund managers seem to have a hard time 'picking the right stocks,' and a high success rate doesn't necessarily mean they'll beat the market. With the second-quarter 13F filing deadline on August 14, the holdings of 24 major institutions have been disclosed, allowing the market to see how many of these top investors have bet on the right direction.

A study of the 24 institutions' holdings shows that, over the 45 trading days from June 30 to August 14, only a few investors had more than half of their funds allocated to stocks that outperformed the S&P 500.
Viking Global and Temasek tied for first place with a 66.7% 'hit rate,' meaning that about two-thirds of their holdings were in stocks that outperformed the S&P 500 during the period.
The stock-picking hit rate ranking shows the percentage of funds allocated to stocks that outperformed the S&P 500:
Notably, even Renaissance Technologies, a leading quant fund, had a stock-picking success rate of only slightly above 50% during this period.

Looking at the overall sample, 15 of the 24 institutions had a hit rate below 50%, with a median of 44.3%. In other words, most institutions allocated more than half of their funds to stocks that did not outperform the S&P 500 during this period.
However, looking at the 'hit rate' alone is not enough to measure investment performance.

If we combine the holdings of the 24 institutions, covering over 5,000 stocks and a total of over $1.2 trillion, 52.3% of the funds were allocated to stocks that outperformed the S&P 500 during the period, but the combined portfolio's return was only 3.57%, lower than the S&P 500's 3.96%.

This reflects that stock-picking success rate and final investment returns are not the same thing. Even if more than half of the funds were allocated to stocks that outperformed the market, if the wrong stocks fell sharply or the right stocks did not rise enough, the overall performance could still lag the index.

For large institutions, investment decisions cannot be made solely based on individual stock performance. When managing hundreds of billions or even trillions of dollars, they must also consider market liquidity, fund size, and redemption, which are different from the conditions faced by individual investors.

Analysis suggests that this study is more noteworthy for what it shows, not which institution is the 'best stock picker.' It shows that even the most closely watched professional investment institutions have a hard time letting most of their funds consistently outperform the market over a 45-trading-day period.

Additionally, 13F itself has clear limitations. The filing data mainly reflects long positions in US stocks and does not cover short positions, futures, non-US stocks, or cash positions, so investors only see a part of the institution's investment portfolio.

At the same time, 13F reflects the holdings as of the end of the quarter, with the latest filing date on August 14. This means that trades made between the end of the quarter and the filing date are not immediately reflected in this public data, so it is not possible to determine from 13F alone whether the institution continued to hold the relevant stocks during this period.

Furthermore, the 24 institutions in this study are a specific tracking sample and not a random sample, so the rankings cannot be directly taken as a representation of the overall investment performance of all institutions.

Citadel's data also has special characteristics. According to SEC filing rules, its filing includes inventory from its own market-making business, which is not comparable to the holdings of a pure investment-focused hedge fund.

As for the other aspects of this study that have not been disclosed, including the complete ranking of the 24 institutions, the buying and selling activity, and the performance of the 'sell' decisions, as well as further analysis of the correlations between the rankings, it has been found that some of the lists may actually reflect similar investment characteristics.
Therefore, 13F provides a snapshot of the holdings as of a specific time point, rather than a comprehensive 'investment master answer sheet.'

Analysts point out that from this data, we can see where large institutions have placed their bets, but to judge their true investment ability, we cannot rely solely on a single quarter's holding hit rate.

items.title: 外資連六買加碼454億、投信翻空 三大法人買超291.06億元
items.title_en: Foreign Institutional Investors Buy for Sixth Consecutive Week, Totaling NT$45.47 Billion, While Institutional Investors Sell for NT$17.747 Billion
paras: 美股上周五收黑，台股今(17)日呈高檔震盪，早盤一度衝上46000點後急殺多空拉鋸震盪，終場加權指數小漲46.26點或0.10%，收在45857.27點，成交量則縮小至9420.25億元；三大法人合計買超291.06億元。
觀察三大法人今天籌碼動向，外資買超454.47億，呈現連六買；自營商買超14.05億元；投信賣超177.47億元，終結連五買，三大法人合計買超291.06億元。
paras_en: The US stock market closed lower last Friday, and the Taiwan stock market today (17th) showed a high-profile fluctuation, with the early session once reaching 46,000 points before rapidly fluctuating between buying and selling, and finally closing the weighted index up 46.26 points or 0.10%, at 45,857.27 points, with a trading volume of 942.025 billion. The total net buy by the three major institutional investors was NT$29.106 billion.

Observing the three major institutional investors' stock movements today, foreign institutional investors had a net buy of NT$45.47 billion, marking the sixth consecutive week of buying; individual investors had a net buy of NT$1.405 billion; and institutional investors had a net sell of NT$17.747 billion, ending five consecutive weeks of buying, with the three major institutional investors having a total net buy of NT$29.106 billion.

items.title: 日本長期利率飆升至30年來新高 市場聚焦日銀9月升息動向
items.title_en: Japan's Long-term Interest Rates Soar to 30-Year High, Focus on BOJ's September Rate Hike
paras: 日本債券市場周一(17日)劇烈波動，作為長期利率指標的新發10年期國債殖利率一度觸及 2.930%，寫下自1996年10月以來、時隔近30年的最高水準。這次漲勢主因在於市場對日本央行(BOJ)加速利息調升的警戒感日益強烈，加上中東局勢引發的原油價格上漲，進一步推升了通膨預期。
儘管最新公布的第二季實質GDP年增率僅為1.1%，低於市場預期的2%，但因內需疲軟被強勁出口抵銷，且生產者物價指數(PPI)仍處於高位，市場對升息的預期並未減弱。目前交換市場反映 9月升息的可能性已攀升至約八成，且市場普遍預期到明年1月前可能會有兩次升息。
財政隱憂也是推升殖利率的關鍵因素。高市早苗政府堅持擴張性財政方針，並提出為期兩年的食品消費稅減稅計畫，卻尚未說明具體的資金來源，引發市場對財政紀律的疑慮。
法國巴黎銀行資產管理公司資深債券策略師木村龍太郎表示：「此前休假的市場參與者已經回歸，並再次將日本央行升息步伐加快的預期納入考慮。」
他指出，儘管美國與日本密切合作，甚至干預了外匯市場，但人們也強烈擔憂高市並未就如何阻止日元貶值或日本央行升息提供任何資訊。除非高市政權能釋出穩定市場的訊號，否則長期利率突破 3% 大關可能只是時間問題。
此外，日元匯率持續低迷，對美元維持在159日元附近，這也增加了日銀為應對進口通膨而升息的壓力。
paras_en: The Japanese bond market experienced a dramatic fluctuation on Monday (17th), with the 10-year government bond yield, a long-term interest rate indicator, reaching 2.930% at one point, a level not seen since October 1996, nearly 30 years ago. The surge in interest rates was primarily driven by the market's growing concern about the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) accelerated interest rate hike, as well as the increase in oil prices triggered by the Middle East situation, further pushing up inflation expectations.

Despite the second-quarter actual GDP growth rate of 1.1%, which was lower than the market's expectation of 2%, the market's expectation of a rate hike has not weakened. The production price index (PPI) remains at a high level, and the market's expectation of a rate hike has not been reduced. The market currently reflects a possibility of a rate hike in September of around 80%, and the market generally expects two rate hikes before January next year.

Fiscal concerns are also a key factor in pushing up interest rates. The Kishida government has insisted on an expansionary fiscal policy and proposed a two-year food consumption tax reduction plan, but has not specified the source of the funds, raising concerns about fiscal discipline.

Jean-Michel Gauthier, a senior bond strategist at French bank BNP Paribas Asset Management, said, 'The market participants who were on vacation have returned, and the expectation of the BOJ's accelerated rate hike has been taken into account again.'

He pointed out that although the US and Japan are closely cooperating and even intervened in the foreign exchange market, people are also strongly worried that the Kishida government has not provided any information on how to prevent the yen from depreciating or the BOJ from raising interest rates. Unless the Kishida government releases a signal to stabilize the market, the long-term interest rate breaking through the 3% barrier may be just a matter of time.

In addition, the yen has continued to depreciate against the US dollar, maintaining a level of around 159 yen, which has increased the pressure on the BOJ to raise interest rates to cope with import-driven inflation.

items.title: 〈億光法說〉車用產品線成Q2營收主要引擎 銅鑼廠Q4交割
items.title_en: EPILED’s Earnings Call: Automotive Products Drive Q2 Revenue, Copper Plant to Close in Q4
paras: LED廠億光(2393-TW)今(17)日召開法人說明會，億光受惠車用產品出貨強勁，車用業務躍居第二季營收成長的主要動能，帶動單季合併營收繳出季增6.4%的亮眼表現。與此同時，公司積極推進資產活化計畫，日前公告處分的台灣銅鑼廠預計將於今年第四季完成交割。
車用產品線成為推升整體業績向上的核心主力，應用範疇廣泛涵蓋車用背光與車載不可見光元件。其餘產品線則呈現持平或小幅變動態勢，目前不可見光產品占比約40%，消費性電子產品占25%，背光與車用產品各占13%，照明產品則占9%。
針對外界關注的銅鑼廠處分案，億光指出相關交易依照進度推進中，預估交割時間落在今年第四季。公司處分該廠主要考量為集中集團內部資源並靈活調配資產配置，藉此提升整體資產報酬率與經營效率，未來全球生產重鎮將聚焦於台灣苑裡、土城，以及中國大陸蘇州與廣東等核心基地。
億光提到，短期內除了銅鑼廠之外並無其他資產處分計畫，將持續把充裕資金與資源投注於具長期成長潛力之策略性投資。
在各產品線獲利表現方面，車用產品因包含毛利較佳的車載背光，其毛利率水準僅次於消費性電子與不可見光，表現明顯優於整體平均值。儘管第二季毛利率受到原物料成本上漲與人民幣匯率波動影響而承壓，但受惠於費用控管與業外評價利益挹注，上半年每股稅後純益仍繳出2.14元水準。
paras_en: LED manufacturer Epiled (2393‑TW) held a corporate briefing today (the 17th). The company benefited from strong shipments of automotive products, with the automotive segment becoming the main driver of second‑quarter revenue growth and delivering a robust 6.4% quarter‑over‑quarter increase in consolidated revenue. At the same time, the firm is actively advancing its asset revitalisation plan and has announced that the disposal of its Taiwan copper‑plant will be completed in the fourth quarter of this year.

The automotive product line is the core engine pushing overall performance higher, covering a wide range of applications such as vehicle backlighting and invisible‑light components for cars. The other product lines are flat or showing only minor changes; currently invisible‑light products account for about 40% of sales, consumer electronics 25%, backlighting and automotive products each 13%, and lighting products 9%.

Regarding the much‑watched copper‑plant disposal, Epiled said the transaction is proceeding on schedule and is expected to close in the fourth quarter of this year. The rationale for selling the plant is to concentrate internal group resources and flexibly re‑allocate assets, thereby improving overall asset returns and operating efficiency. Going forward, the company’s global manufacturing hubs will focus on core sites in Yuanli and Tucheng in Taiwan, as well as Suzhou and Guangdong in mainland China.

Epiled added that, aside from the copper‑plant sale, there are no other asset‑disposal plans in the short term, and it will continue to invest its ample cash and resources into strategic investments with long‑term growth potential.

In terms of profitability across product lines, automotive products—thanks to the higher‑margin vehicle backlighting—rank second only to consumer electronics and invisible‑light products in gross‑margin level, clearly outperforming the overall average. Although Q2 gross margin was pressured by rising raw‑material costs and RMB exchange‑rate fluctuations, effective cost control and non‑operating valuation gains helped the company deliver a first‑half earnings per share of NT$2.14 after tax.

items.title: 賴清德：明年在稅出平衡下每人普發現金1萬元 讓AI紅利全民共享
items.title_en: Tsai Ing-wen: Next Year, Every Person Will Receive NT$10,000 in Cash Under Tax Balance, Let AI Dividends be Shared by All
paras: 行政院於今(17)日上午第2次向總統賴清德報告明(116)年中央總預算編列情形。賴清德在聽取簡報後表示，台灣憑藉長期的半導體、資通訊等供應鏈優勢，經濟成長率上修，今(115)年可望創下39年來新高，明年總預算將在歲入歲出平衡、實質零舉債下，增列2,357億元普發現金予每人1萬元，讓「AI紅利，全民共享」。
賴清德指出，2周前，當他首次聽取「116年度總預算案」報告時，當時他就提到，明年總預算案要在財政穩健的基礎上，兼顧國家安全、經濟發展與人民照顧，也要讓經濟成長的成果由全民共享，這2周行政團隊一方面進行總預算的朝野協商；另一方面，持續進行明年度預算整編。上周五(14日)，主計總處公布最新的經濟數字也可看到，台灣的經濟表現持續上修，相較之前預測更為強韌。
賴清德表示，今年第1季經濟成長率從14.55%上修到15.43%；第2季初步統計也達到12.93%，已連3季呈現雙位數成長，上半年的經濟成長率更達到14.15%，是半世紀以來同期最強表現，今年全年經濟成長率，據主計總處最新預測，從原先的9.64%上修到11.05%，可望創下39年以來新高的紀錄。
賴清德說，這樣亮眼的數字，是全體台灣人民一起打拚的成果，雖面臨動盪的國際政經局勢，面對國內的政治紛擾，依然能夠穩健向前，交出亮眼的成績單，在AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求快速增加，台灣憑藉長期累積的半導體、資通訊及製造供應鏈優勢，相關訂單、出口及投資也持續成長，成為今年經濟強勁成長的重要動能。
然而，賴清德也強調，必須正視，經濟成長是全民共同創造，但每一個人感受到成長速度並不完全相同，AI蓬勃發展、科技業出口暢旺，是台灣的機會，但在科技業之外，還有更多國人，每一天在服務業、在傳產、在中小微企業殷勤打拚。
政府也不會只關注科技產業的高峰，因此伴隨經濟成長上修，明年總預算歲入，也上修到3兆9,266億元，在歲入歲出平衡前提下，決定增列2,357億元，用來明年普發現金，每人1萬元，全民共享。
賴清德也說，這1萬元怎麼使用，由每個人、每個家庭自己決定，可以拿來支付孩子的教育費，可以照顧長輩，可以減輕家庭負擔，也可以增加消費、支持在地店家及百工百業。但他也強調，普發現金納入整體預算後，明年度總預算仍然維持收支平衡，債務淨額沒有增加，要照顧人民眼前的需要，也對未來的世代負責，分享經濟成長的果實，也守住國家財政的紀律。
paras_en: The Executive Yuan reported to President Tsai Ing-wen on the central government's budget for next year. After listening to the report, Tsai Ing-wen stated that Taiwan's economy is expected to grow at a rate that will be the highest in 39 years, thanks to its long-term advantages in the semiconductor and ICT supply chains. The budget for next year will be balanced, with no debt increase, and an additional NT$235.7 billion will be allocated to give every person NT$10,000 in cash, allowing everyone to share in the 'AI dividend'.

Tsai Ing-wen pointed out that two weeks ago, when he first heard the report on the '2024 budget', he mentioned that the budget for next year should be based on a stable financial foundation, taking into account national security, economic development, and people's welfare, and that the results of economic growth should be shared by all. Over the past two weeks, the administrative team has been engaged in cross-party negotiations on the budget and has continued to review and revise the budget for next year.

Tsai Ing-wen stated that the economic growth rate for the first quarter of this year has been revised upward from 14.55% to 15.43%, and the preliminary statistics for the second quarter also reached 12.93%, with three consecutive quarters of double-digit growth. The economic growth rate for the first half of the year reached 14.15%, the strongest performance in half a century. According to the latest forecast by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, the annual economic growth rate is expected to be revised upward from 9.64% to 11.05%, which would be a new high in 39 years.

Tsai Ing-wen said that these impressive numbers are the result of the joint efforts of all Taiwanese people. Despite facing a turbulent international political and economic situation and domestic political turmoil, Taiwan has been able to move forward steadily and achieve remarkable results. With the rapid growth in demand for AI, high-performance computing, and cloud services, Taiwan's long-term accumulation of advantages in the semiconductor, ICT, and manufacturing supply chains has led to continuous growth in related orders, exports, and investment, which has become an important driving force for this year's strong economic growth.

However, Tsai Ing-wen also emphasized that it is necessary to recognize that economic growth is a joint creation of all people, but the speed of growth is not felt equally by everyone. The prosperity of AI and the booming export of the tech industry are opportunities for Taiwan, but outside of the tech industry, there are many more people who are working hard every day in the service industry, traditional industries, and small and medium-sized enterprises.

The government will not only focus on the high points of the tech industry. With the upward revision of economic growth, next year's total budget revenue will also be revised upward to NT$3.9266 trillion. On the premise of balancing revenue and expenditure, it has been decided to add NT$235.7 billion to distribute NT$10,000 in cash to every person next year, allowing everyone to share in the benefits.

Tsai Ing-wen also said that how the NT$10,000 is used will be decided by each individual and each family. It can be used to pay for children's education, take care of the elderly, reduce family burdens, or increase consumption and support local businesses and industries. However, he also emphasized that after the cash distribution is included in the overall budget, the total budget for next year will still maintain a balance between revenue and expenditure, and the net debt will not increase. The government needs to take care of people's immediate needs while being responsible to future generations, sharing the fruits of economic growth while maintaining the discipline of national finances.

items.title: 天能綠電拿下欣銓10年長約 搶AI半導體綠電商機
items.title_en: Tieneng Secures 10-Year Contract with Hsinchu to Supply Green Electricity to AI Semiconductor Industry
paras: 雲豹能源(6869-TW)旗下售電子公司天能綠電(7842-TW)今(17)日宣布與半導體測試大廠欣銓(3264-TW)續簽綠電轉供合作，雙方此次簽訂10年期綠電採購合約，總轉供量達5.5億度。天能綠電將整合集團發電案場與外部合作電廠綠電資源，自明年1月起正式轉供欣銓科技使用，協助企業穩定取得綠電，加速低碳轉型。
欣銓為台灣前三大晶圓測試廠，已於2023年正式加入全球再生能源倡議組織RE100，並於2026年通過科學基礎減量目標倡議(Science Based Targets initiative, SBTi)近期減碳目標審查。
欣銓自2023年起即與天能綠電合作綠電轉供，首期合作累計交易電量約3,900萬度。此次續簽10年綠電採購合約，總交易電量提升至5.5億度，不僅反映企業綠電需求持續升溫，也顯示長期綠電採購已逐漸成為企業能源管理的重要方向。
此外，欣銓規劃於2040年達成RE60目標，此次與天能綠電長期合作，正是欣銓實踐RE100與SBTi承諾的關鍵具體行動，將進一步提升再生能源使用比例，積極因應AI應用帶動的用電成長，以及全球供應鏈日益提升的減碳要求。
天能綠電總經理唐亞聖表示，企業採購綠電不再只是因應法規要求，而是企業永續經營與全球競爭力的重要基礎。隨著AI應用快速發展，半導體等高科技產業對穩定電力與綠電供應的需求持續提升。欣銓科技積極加入RE100與SBTi等國際倡議，並付諸長期能源規劃，展現了高科技產業在永續發展上的前瞻性與決心，這也是企業面對國際減碳推進時，強化綠色供應鏈競爭力的最佳典範。
唐亞聖表示，在AI帶動產業升級趨勢下，企業對長期、穩定綠電供應的需求將持續增加，綠電採購也將從永續管理，逐步成為強化全球綠色供應鏈競爭力的重要基礎。
根據能源署售電月報統計，天能綠電2025年綠電轉供量近4.2億度，2026年1至6月綠電交易量已達3.05億度，穩居國內民營售電業第一。未來，天能綠電將持續強化綠電交易規模與能源管理服務，協助企業建構更具韌性的低碳能源布局。
paras_en: Tieneng Renewable Energy (7842-TW), a subsidiary of Cloud Leopard Energy (6869-TW), announced on 17th that it has signed a 10-year green electricity supply agreement with Hsinchu (3264-TW), a leading semiconductor testing company. The total supply volume is 550 million kWh. Tieneng Renewable Energy will integrate its group's power generation projects with external cooperative power plants to supply green electricity to Hsinchu Technology from January next year, helping the company to stabilize its green electricity supply and accelerate its low-carbon transformation.

Hsinchu is one of Taiwan's top three wafer testing companies and has officially joined the global renewable energy advocacy organization RE100 since 2023. It has also passed the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term carbon reduction target review in 2026.

Hsinchu has been cooperating with Tieneng Renewable Energy on green electricity supply since 2023. The initial cooperation has completed a total of approximately 39 million kWh of electricity transactions. This time, the 10-year green electricity supply agreement has increased the total electricity transactions to 550 million kWh, not only reflecting the continuous warming of corporate green electricity demand but also showing that long-term green electricity procurement has become an important direction of corporate energy management.

In addition, Hsinchu plans to achieve the RE60 goal by 2040. This time, the long-term cooperation with Tieneng Renewable Energy is a key specific action to implement Hsinchu's commitment to RE100 and SBTi, which will further increase the proportion of renewable energy use, actively respond to the growth of electricity consumption driven by AI applications, and the increasing demand for carbon reduction in the global supply chain.

Tieneng Renewable Energy General Manager Tang Yasheng said that corporate green electricity procurement is no longer just a response to regulatory requirements, but an important foundation for corporate sustainable operation and global competitiveness. With the rapid development of AI applications, the high-tech industry, including semiconductors, continues to increase its demand for stable power and green electricity supply. Hsinchu Technology actively joins RE100 and SBTI international advocacy and makes long-term energy planning, showing a forward-looking and determined attitude towards sustainable development, which is also the best example of strengthening green supply chain competitiveness in the face of international carbon reduction promotion.

Tang Yasheng said that under the trend of industry upgrading driven by AI, corporate demand for long-term and stable green electricity supply will continue to increase, and green electricity procurement will gradually become an important foundation for strengthening global green supply chain competitiveness.

According to the Energy Bureau's sales report, Tieneng Renewable Energy's green electricity supply volume in 2025 was approximately 420 million kWh, and the green electricity transaction volume from January to June 2026 was 305 million kWh, ranking first in the domestic private sales industry. In the future, Tieneng Renewable Energy will continue to strengthen its green electricity trading scale and energy management services to help enterprises build a more resilient low-carbon energy layout.

items.title: 高息月配吸睛！00984D規模和受益人成長奪雙冠 第5次續配0.085元最晚8/31卡位
items.title_en: Eye‑catching High‑Yield Monthly Distribution! 00984D Wins Dual Crown for Scale and Beneficiary Growth, 5th Distribution of NT$0.085 Latest by Aug 31
paras: 近期全球股市劇烈震盪，主動式債券ETF憑藉靈活配置與收益優勢吸引市場目光。其中，聯博優選全球非投資等級債券主動式ETF（00984D-TW）靠著吸睛的亮眼配息率躍升市場寵兒，本月新增受益人數一舉奪下同類型主動式債券ETF冠軍，單月增幅高達10.83%、總受益人數衝上10614人，堪稱近期人氣最旺的債券ETF標的。00984D預計於9月1日進行第5次除息，每受益權單位預估配息金額為0.085元，持續維持穩定高息水準，投資人若想參與本次配息，8月31日為最後買進日。
將同類型主動式債券ETF表現相比，00984D不論在規模或受益人數上均展現強勁爆發力。截至8月14日，其基金資產規模已由成立初期的14.9億元暴增至83.5億元，增幅高達460%；受益人數自成立以來更成長356%，本月表現更是遠優於其他同型標的。

聯博投信 ETF 發展部副總經理鍾郁婕表示，面對股市震盪、利率走向與地緣政治等不確定因素，投資人對「降低波動」與「穩定現金流」的需求日益增加，帶動資金湧入非投資等級債市。截至8月7日單周，全球非投資等級債市淨流入達35億美元，顯見資金加速轉向具高息優勢的固定收益資產。針對收益型投資人的資產配置，00984D採月中收益評價，投資人可搭配採月底收益評價的00980D聯博投資等級債入息主動式ETF，自組類「雙周收益」網絡，讓資金安排更具彈性與節奏。

聯博投信投資策略師陳若梅則指出，近期股市與半導體類股大幅修正，凸顯股債配置的重要性。在全球不確定性高漲及利率高檔環境下，非投等債具備四大優勢：第一，波動度遠低於台股與半導體股，能有效防禦市場震盪；第二，涵蓋消費、能源與科技等多元產業，可分散單一產業景氣風險；第三，平均存續期間約3.6年，較短天期特性可降低對利率變動的敏感度；第四，目前殖利率達7.2%，優於公債與投資等級債，提供極具吸引力的收益水準。

paras_en: Recent global equity markets have been highly volatile, and actively managed bond ETFs have attracted market attention with their flexible allocation and yield advantages. Among them, the Lianbo Selected Global Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond Active ETF (00984D‑TW) has become a market darling thanks to its striking dividend yield. This month it added the most new beneficiaries, seizing the champion title among similar active bond ETFs, with a monthly increase of 10.83% and a total beneficiary count soaring to 10,614, making it the most popular bond ETF recently. 00984D is scheduled to conduct its 5th ex‑dividend on September 1, with an estimated dividend of NT$0.085 per unit of beneficiary right, maintaining a stable high‑yield level; investors who wish to participate must purchase by the last day, August 31.

Compared with other active bond ETFs of the same type, 00984D shows strong explosive growth in both scale and beneficiary numbers. As of August 14, its fund assets have surged from the initial NT$14.9 billion at inception to NT$83.5 billion, a rise of 460%. Since its launch, the number of beneficiaries has grown 356%, and this month’s performance far outpaces other comparable funds.

Zhong Yu‑jie, Deputy General Manager of the ETF Development Department at Lianbo Asset Management, said that amid market turbulence, interest‑rate trends and geopolitical uncertainties, investors’ demand for “lower volatility” and “stable cash flow” is increasing, driving inflows into the non‑investment‑grade bond market. In the week ending August 7, net inflows into the global non‑investment‑grade bond market reached US$3.5 billion, indicating a rapid shift toward high‑yield fixed‑income assets. For income‑focused investors, 00984D uses a mid‑month yield valuation, which can be paired with the end‑of‑month yield‑valued 00980D Lianbo Investment‑Grade Bond Income Active ETF to create a “bi‑weekly income” network, offering more flexible and rhythmic cash‑flow planning.

Chen Ruo‑mei, Investment Strategist at Lianbo Asset Management, pointed out that the recent sharp correction in equities and semiconductor stocks highlights the importance of stock‑bond allocation. In a climate of heightened global uncertainty and high interest rates, non‑investment‑grade bonds have four major advantages: first, volatility is far lower than that of Taiwanese equities and semiconductor stocks, effectively shielding against market swings; second, they cover diverse sectors such as consumer, energy and technology, diversifying single‑industry risk; third, the average duration is about 3.6 years, a relatively short term that reduces sensitivity to rate changes; fourth, the current yield stands at 7.2%, outperforming government bonds and investment‑grade bonds and offering an extremely attractive return level.

items.title: 外資連六買加碼454億、投信翻空 三大法人買超291.06億元
items.title_en: Foreign Institutional Investors Buy for Sixth Consecutive Week, Totaling NT$45.47 Billion, While Institutional Investors Sell for NT$17.747 Billion
paras: 美股上周五收黑，台股今(17)日呈高檔震盪，早盤一度衝上46000點後急殺多空拉鋸震盪，終場加權指數小漲46.26點或0.10%，收在45857.27點，成交量則縮小至9420.25億元；三大法人合計買超291.06億元。
觀察三大法人今天籌碼動向，外資買超454.47億，呈現連六買；自營商買超14.05億元；投信賣超177.47億元，終結連五買，三大法人合計買超291.06億元。
paras_en: The US stock market closed lower last Friday, and the Taiwan stock market today (17th) showed a high-profile fluctuation, with the early session once reaching 46,000 points before rapidly fluctuating between buying and selling, and finally closing the weighted index up 46.26 points or 0.10%, at 45,857.27 points, with a trading volume of 942.025 billion. The total net buy by the three major institutional investors was NT$29.106 billion.

Observing the three major institutional investors' stock movements today, foreign institutional investors had a net buy of NT$45.47 billion, marking the sixth consecutive week of buying; individual investors had a net buy of NT$1.405 billion; and institutional investors had a net sell of NT$17.747 billion, ending five consecutive weeks of buying, with the three major institutional investors having a total net buy of NT$29.106 billion.

items.title: 台新新光金連九度獲HR Asia最佳雇主肯定 再獲北市府友善育兒事業獎
items.title_en: Taiwan Shin Kong Financial Holding Wins HR Asia Best Employer Award for 9th Consecutive Year
paras: 台新新光金控於人才發展與友善職場經營再獲肯定，榮獲HR Asia「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」及台北市政府勞動局115年度「友善育兒事業獎」績優事業組殊榮，展現企業在人才培育、職場文化及育兒友善措施上的長期投入與卓越成果。

台新新光金控人資處長張南星表示，HR ASIA「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」為亞洲區最具代表性的人力資源獎項之一，評選方式為邀請員工匿名填寫問卷，針對雇主表現進行評分，並由《HR ASIA》召集相關領域專家，就企業人力資源投入項目進行資料審查與評比，其評選範圍涵蓋12個國家地區，台新新光金控在各項指標表現均優於產業平均，從330間參賽企業中脫穎而出，連續九年獲得肯定。此外，台新新光金控憑藉深耕人才培育、優化職場環境的傑出表現，首度摘下「人才躍升獎」，充分展現打造多元共融職場環境的具體成果深獲肯定。在另一方面，台新新光金控關心員工在不同人生階段的需求，發揮以人為本、同創共好的精神，打造兼具溫度與韌性的幸福職場，相關作為也榮獲台北市政府勞動局115年度「友善育兒事業獎」績優事業組殊榮。
張南星說明台新新光金控持續積極打造友善職場環境，提供員工全方位的福利措施，包括提供優於法令的70天產假、10天產檢假及8天陪產假、每年2日全薪好孕假，並提供可遞延使用之健檢補助，同時擴大子女教育補助範圍與金額，讓員工在不同人生階段皆能安心兼顧工作與家庭。除制度支持外，亦持續開辦多元身心健康講座及軟性課程，如親子工作坊、穴位保健、母性育嬰等，從健康促進到家庭互動，全方位照顧員工的身心健康。
張南星強調讓員工在充滿尊重與關懷的環境中工作，企業方能持續創造社會價值與永續影響力，員工幸福才是企業永續的根基。未來台新新光金控將持續傾聽員工心聲，貼近員工需求，並提供更優質的工作體驗，成為每一位員工信賴的最佳夥伴，朝向具高度韌性與溫度的最佳永續雇主品牌邁進。
paras_en: Taiwan Shin Kong Financial Holding has once again been recognized for its talent development and friendly workplace operations, winning the HR Asia "Asia's Best Employer Award" and the Taipei City Government Labor Bureau's 115th "Friendly Child-Rearing Business Award" for outstanding businesses, showcasing the company's long-term investment and outstanding results in talent cultivation, workplace culture, and child-friendly measures.

Taiwan Shin Kong Financial Holding's Human Resources Director, Zhang Nanxing, said that the HR ASIA "Asia's Best Employer Award" is one of the most representative human resource awards in the Asian region, with a selection process that invites employees to fill out anonymous questionnaires, evaluates employer performance, and has experts from the relevant fields review and compare the company's human resource investment projects. The selection scope covers 12 countries and regions, and Taiwan Shin Kong Financial Holding has performed better than the industry average in all indicators, emerging from 330 participating companies and winning the award for the 9th consecutive year.

Zhang Nanxing explained that Taiwan Shin Kong Financial Holding has been deeply cultivating talent development, optimizing the workplace environment, and has won the "Talent Leap Award" for the first time, fully demonstrating the specific results of creating a diverse and inclusive workplace environment. On the other hand, Taiwan Shin Kong Financial Holding is concerned about the needs of employees at different stages of their lives, and has implemented the spirit of putting people first and creating shared value, creating a workplace that is both warm and resilient, and has won the Taipei City Government Labor Bureau's 115th "Friendly Child-Rearing Business Award" for outstanding businesses.

Zhang Nanxing emphasized that Taiwan Shin Kong Financial Holding has been actively creating a friendly workplace environment, providing employees with comprehensive welfare measures, including providing 70 days of maternity leave, 10 days of prenatal leave, and 8 days of paternity leave, and providing annual paid leave for new mothers, as well as providing delayed payment for health checks, and expanding the scope and amount of child education subsidies, allowing employees to feel secure and balance work and family responsibilities at different stages of their lives. In addition to institutional support, the company has continued to organize diverse health and wellness lectures and soft courses, such as parent-child workshops, acupressure health, and maternal and infant care, from health promotion to family interaction, providing comprehensive care for employees' physical and mental health.

items.title: 〈車市〉捷博看汽車美容市場進入爆發期 下半年單月有望轉獲利
items.title_en: KeePer PROSHOP Taiwan Agent, Jetebo, Sees Taiwan's Car Aftermarket Entering an Explosive Period
paras: 隨著全台汽車保有量來到 872 萬台，平均持有年限更拉長至 11.1 年，日本知名汽車美容與鍍膜品牌 KeePer PROSHOP 的台灣代理商捷博(7831-TW)表示，台灣車市正出現「買車降溫、養車升溫」的消費轉變，已感受到後市場服務的爆發期，在此趨勢下，下半年單月有望轉獲利，預計申請上櫃時程最快在明年。
捷博董事長彭仕邦表示，不同於新車市場降溫，國內汽車美容產業仍逆勢成長，消費重心正從「功能性用車」逐步轉向「精緻化用車」，帶動汽車售後服務需求持續成長。
因此，捷博目標持續打造以車主為核心的汽車售後服務生態圈，整合汽車美容、輪胎、保養和微鈑金，加上會員與異業合作等多元服務，成為汽車美容的複合式服務場域。
捷博目前串聯有「日本第一連鎖鍍膜品牌 KeePer PRO SHOP」、「米其林馳加輪胎」和「捷匠PDR 微鈑金」完整涵蓋汽車美容、保養、輪胎與微鈑金需求，直營據點達全台15家，多為300-600坪的大型店，且有3分之2據點穩定貢獻獲利。
彭仕邦表示，汽車後市場不受新車市場衰退影響，反而迎來服務的爆發期，原因在於國內車口高齡，平均達11.1年，樂觀看待台灣汽美市場進入價值展現時代，接下來期望開設，定出更有制度、更有保障、也更具生活體驗感的產業新標準，甚至成為車主的日常生活場景。
捷博規劃，短期均維持直營，並朝向中小店型發展。
paras_en: With Taiwan's total car ownership reaching 8.72 million and the average holding period lengthening to 11.1 years, Jetebo (7831-TW), the Taiwan agent for Japanese car beauty and coating brand KeePer PROSHOP, stated that Taiwan's car market is experiencing a shift from 'buying cars to cool down' to 'caring for cars to warm up', and has already felt the explosive period of the after-sales service market. Under this trend, it is expected that the company will turn a profit in the second half of the year, with the IPO application process expected to be completed as early as next year.

Jetebo Chairman Peng Shih-pang stated that, unlike the cooling down of the new car market, the domestic car beauty industry is still growing against the trend, with consumers shifting their focus from 'functional vehicles' to 'refined vehicles', driving the demand for after-sales services to continue growing.

Therefore, Jetebo aims to continue building a car after-sales service ecosystem centered on car owners, integrating car beauty, tires, maintenance, and micro-gold plating, as well as member and cross-industry collaborations, to become a comprehensive service field for car beauty.

Jetebo currently has a network of 'Japan's first chain coating brand KeePer PRO SHOP', 'Michelin tire', and 'Jetebo PDR micro-gold plating' that covers the entire range of car beauty, maintenance, tires, and micro-gold plating needs, with 15 directly operated stores across Taiwan, mostly large stores with an area of 300-600 square meters, and with two-thirds of the stores consistently contributing to profits.

Peng Shih-pang stated that the car after-market is not affected by the decline of the new car market, but rather is entering a period of explosive growth, due to the high age of Taiwan's car population, with an average age of 11.1 years. He is optimistic about Taiwan's car beauty market entering an era of value presentation, and expects to establish a new industry standard with more systems, more security, and more life experience, and even become a daily life scene for car owners.
Jetebo plans to maintain its direct operation in the short term and develop towards medium and small-sized stores.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉台積電守住2400元漲46點 成交量跌破兆元闖關4萬6又失利
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market: TSMC Holds at NT$2400, Rising 46 Points, with Trading Volume Below NT$1 Trillion
paras: 美國7月零售銷售下滑，美股上周五收黑，台股今(17)日呈高檔震盪，早盤一度衝上46000點後急殺多空拉鋸震盪，終場加權指數小漲46.26點或0.10%，收在45857.27點，成交量則收窄至9420.25億元。
觀察權值股表現，台積電(2330-TW)收2400元，微幅上漲0.21%；聯電(2303-TW)也收紅；台達電(2308-TW)開高後回吐漲幅，終場以平盤作收；鴻海(2317-TW)亦呈震盪走低，下跌1.73%，日月光投控(3711-TW)收黑。
高價股方面，股王信驊(5274-TW)跌近3.8%，股后川湖(2059-TW)挾單月大賺5個股本的強悍氣勢，強勢攻上漲停13750元新天價；健策(3653-TW)、大立光(3008-TW)雙雙漲停，站穩5000元之上，聯亞(3081-TW)也漲停；但旺矽(6223-TW)、力旺(3529-TW) 則聯袂打入跌停。
另外，研調機構SemiAnalysis 最新報告指出，Google 轉向與超微(AMD)合作第十代 TPU，市場擔憂衝擊Google TPU供應鏈的聯發科(2454-TW)，股價挫3.8%，ASIC相關的世芯-KY(3661-TW)也跌3.56%，但創意(3443-TW)仍大漲7%。
族群方面，ABF載板三雄中，欣興(3037-TW)亮燈漲停，景碩(3189-TW)漲近5%，惟南電(8046-TW)收黑；PCB相關的台光電(2383-TW)漲3%，臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)也走揚；航運族群表現強勢，貨櫃海運三雄中，萬海(2615-TW)漲停，陽明(2609-TW)、長榮(2603-TW)漲幅均約6%上下，航空雙雄長榮航(2618-TW)、華航(2610-TW)也同步走揚。
品牌與板卡族群則明顯承壓，技嘉(2376-TW)落入跌停，微星(2377-TW)、華碩(2357-TW)跌約6%；代工廠的英業達(2356-TW)、和碩(4938-TW)也跌逾4%，記憶體族群方面，旺宏(2337-TW)、力積電(6770-TW)跌約半根停版，南亞科(2408-TW)則收漲2%。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market experienced a high-profile fluctuation today, with the index rising 46.26 points or 0.10% to close at 45857.27. Trading volume, however, declined to NT$942.025 billion.

Among the heavyweight stocks, TSMC (2330-TW) closed at NT$2400, rising 0.21%. United Microelectronics (2303-TW) also closed in the green, while Delta Electronics (2308-TW) opened high but gave back its gains to close flat. Hon Hai (2317-TW) also experienced a volatile decline, falling 1.73%, while Dayax (3711-TW) closed in the red.

High-priced stocks, such as Foxconn (5274-TW), fell nearly 3.8%, while Shinko (2059-TW) rose sharply, reaching a new high of NT$13750. Other high-priced stocks, including Jenoptik (3653-TW), Largan (3008-TW), and Lianya (3081-TW), also rose to their limits, while Unimicron (6223-TW) and Powerchip (3529-TW) fell to their limits.

In addition, research firm SemiAnalysis recently released a report indicating that Google is shifting its focus to collaborating with AMD on the 10th generation TPU, which has raised concerns about the impact on Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (2454-TW), causing its stock price to fall 3.8%. Other stocks related to ASIC, such as Sino IC (3661-TW), also fell 3.56%, while Creative (3443-TW) rose 7%.

In terms of industry groups, among the top three PCB companies, Hua Hsin (3037-TW) rose to its limit, while Jabil (3189-TW) rose nearly 5%. However, Nan Ya Plastics (8046-TW) closed in the red. Other PCB-related stocks, such as Taiwan Semiconductor (2383-TW) and Zenith (4958-TW), also rose. The shipping industry group performed strongly, with the top three container shipping companies, Wan Hai (2615-TW), Yang Ming (2609-TW), and Evergreen (2603-TW), rising 6% or more. The top two airlines, Evergreen Airlines (2618-TW) and China Airlines (2610-TW), also rose.

The brand and motherboard group, however, was under pressure, with Gigabyte (2376-TW) falling to its limit. Other brands, such as Microstar (2377-TW) and ASUS (2357-TW), fell 6%. Contract manufacturers, including Foxconn (2356-TW) and Winbond (4938-TW), also fell more than 4%. The memory industry group also experienced a decline, with Winbond (2337-TW) and Powerchip (6770-TW) falling 50% or more, while South Asia (2408-TW) rose 2%.

items.title: 顯卡價格狂飆 但真正漲的不是GPU 而是GDDR7顯存
items.title_en: GPU Prices Soar, But the Real Driver of Cost Increases is GDDR7 Memory
paras: 8 月顯卡漲價潮愈演愈烈，RTX 5090、RTX 5080 市場價格一路走高，超AMD(AMD-US) 也宣布調漲 RX 9000 系列售價 10% 至 15%。但這波顯卡大漲，真正推高成本的主角並非 GPU，而是過去較不顯眼的GDDR7 顯存。
隨著 AI 伺服器大量搶占先進記憶體產能，記憶體大廠將資源轉向獲利更高的 HBM，排擠消費級 GDDR7 供應。
如今 RTX 5090 光是顯存成本就約占官方建議售價 16%，顯卡產業正迎來一場成本結構逆轉：過去買顯卡主要是在為 GPU 算力付費，如今愈來愈多成本，正在被顯存吃掉。
根據新浪財經 8 月 4 日數據，一顆 2GB GDDR7 顯存現貨價格已超過 20 美元，以 RTX 5090 搭載 16 顆計算，光是顯存成本就約 320 美元，約占官方建議售價 1999 美元的 16%，而且還未計入 GPU 核心、PCB、散熱與供電模組。
這意味顯卡的成本結構正出現變化，過去消費者買高階顯卡，主要是在為 GPU 算力付費，如今愈來愈高的成本正被記憶體吃掉。
AI搶產能 GDDR7成稀缺資源
顯存突然變貴，關鍵並不完全出在顯卡市場，而是記憶體大廠重新分配產能。
消費級顯卡採用的 GDDR7，與 AI 伺服器大量需求的高頻寬記憶體（HBM），都需要先進記憶體製程產能。
對三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 與美光(MU-US) 而言，相較於消費級 GDDR，將晶圓投入 HBM，再供應輝達及雲端服務業者，具有更高的獲利空間，因此三大記憶體原廠近年持續將先進產能向 HBM 傾斜。
更關鍵的是輝達本身的產品取捨。2026 年上半年輝達主動削減 30% 至 40% 的 RTX 50 系列消費級顯卡產能，將原先配置給消費市場的記憶體供應轉向獲利率更高的資料中心產品。
當上游資源持續往 AI 集中，顯卡漲價也就不只是通路囤貨炒作，而是背後供應結構發生改變。
不同於挖礦潮 AI需求更具結構性
上一輪顯卡價格失控發生在 2021 年，主要推力來自加密貨幣挖礦，需求具有高度投機性；這次則不同，背後是大型科技公司持續擴張 AI 資料中心。
微軟(MSFT-US) 、Google、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Meta(META-US) 與甲骨文(ORCL-US) 2026 年合計資本支出預估達 6600 億至 6900 億美元，相關支出已納入基礎設施建設計畫。
當 AI 伺服器持續爭搶 HBM，記憶體廠自然更有誘因將有限產能投入高毛利產品，進一步排擠消費級市場。
記憶體漲價的利益也沿著供應鏈重新分配。三星記憶體業務營收年增 471%，SK 海力士 DRAM 平均售價季增 30%；鎧俠單季淨利從 183 億日元增至 8422 億日元，宇瞻第二季淨利更年增 19.87 倍、毛利率達 51%。
上游吃紅利 終端消費者買單
產業鏈最上游的三星、SK 海力士與美光成為這輪漲價循環主要受益者，並透過把產能從低毛利消費級記憶體移向高毛利 HBM，進一步掌握產能與定價權。
夾在中間的輝達、AMD 與板卡廠，一方面享受 AI 需求成長，另一方面也面臨顯存成本攀升壓力。
技嘉 8 月 1 日將 GPU 訂單價格調高 20% 至 40%，AMD 對 RX 9000 系列調漲 10% 至 15%，都反映上游成本逐步向下游轉嫁。最後承擔價格壓力的，則是組裝電腦用戶、遊戲玩家與中小企業。
短期而言，中國本土供應鏈也難以完全填補缺口。雖然中國 AI 晶片已在政務、金融等領域逐步擴大應用，但在消費級顯卡與中小企業現貨市場，GPU 產能、軟體生態與開發者支援仍存在差距；GDDR7 與 HBM 等先進記憶體的核心供應能力，也仍主要掌握在三星、SK 海力士與美光手中。
算力瓶頸從GPU轉向記憶體
這波顯存漲價更值得注意的是，算力產業的瓶頸正在改變。隨著 GPU 運算密度持續提高，決定系統效能的不再只是晶片本身有多快，也包括記憶體能否以足夠高的頻寬，把資料即時送進運算單元。
AI 伺服器爭奪 HBM，高階顯卡需要 GDDR7，手機、PC 與遊戲主機則需要 DRAM，看似分屬不同市場，背後卻都在競逐有限的先進記憶體產能。
當原本只是物料清單（BOM）其中一環的記憶體成本快速攀升，硬體廠商的成本控制、供應鏈配置乃至產品策略，都可能因此重新調整。
換言之，這輪顯卡漲價表面看似 RTX 5090、RTX 5080 等高階產品價格失控，真正的主角卻逐漸從 GPU 轉向顯存。只要 AI 資料中心仍持續吸收先進記憶體產能，消費級顯卡面臨的供應與成本壓力就難以迅速消失。
這次顯卡漲瘋了，但真正漲得最兇的，可能不是那顆最受矚目的 GPU，而是旁邊一顆顆過去較少被消費者注意的顯存。
paras_en: The GPU price surge in August is intensifying, with the RTX 5090 and RTX 5080 market prices rising steadily, and AMD also announcing a 10% to 15% price increase for the RX 9000 series. However, the recent GPU price surge is not driven by the GPU itself, but rather by the relatively less visible GDDR7 memory.
As AI servers continue to occupy advanced memory production capacity, memory manufacturers are shifting resources to more profitable HBM, squeezing out consumer-grade GDDR7 supplies.

Today, the RTX 5090's display memory cost alone accounts for about 16% of its official recommended price, and the GPU industry is facing a cost structure reversal: in the past, consumers bought GPUs primarily to pay for their computing power, but now, more and more costs are being eaten up by memory.

According to Sina Finance data on August 4, a 2GB GDDR7 memory chip has a current market price of over $20, and with the RTX 5090 equipped with 16 cores, the display memory cost alone is approximately $320, accounting for about 16% of the official recommended price of $1,999, not including GPU cores, PCB, heat dissipation, and power modules.
This means that the cost structure of graphics cards is changing, and consumers who buy high-end graphics cards are now paying more for memory than for GPU computing power.
AI is competing for HBM, making GDDR7 a scarce resource.
The sudden increase in memory prices is not entirely due to the graphics card market, but rather the memory manufacturers' reallocation of production capacity.
Consumer-grade graphics cards use GDDR7, while AI servers require high-bandwidth memory (HBM), both of which require advanced memory production capacity.

For Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS), and Micron (MU-US), compared to consumer-grade GDDR, investing in HBM for high-margin products for companies like NVIDIA and cloud service providers offers higher profit margins, so the three major memory manufacturers have been shifting their advanced production capacity to HBM in recent years.

More importantly, NVIDIA's product selection has a significant impact. In the first half of 2026, NVIDIA actively reduced production capacity for consumer-grade RTX 50 series graphics cards by 30% to 40%, redirecting the original memory supply to more profitable data center products.
As upstream resources continue to flow towards AI, the recent GPU price surge is not just a result of channel hoarding and speculation, but rather a change in the supply structure.
Unlike the 2021 GPU price surge, which was driven by cryptocurrency mining with high speculative demand, this time the driver is the continuous expansion of AI data centers by major tech companies.

Microsoft (MSFT-US), Google, Amazon (AMZN-US), Meta (META-US), and Oracle (ORCL-US) are expected to spend a combined $66 billion to $69 billion in 2026, with related expenditures included in infrastructure development plans.
As AI servers continue to compete for HBM, memory manufacturers naturally have more incentives to invest in high-margin products, further squeezing out the consumer market.

The benefits of memory price increases are also being redistributed along the supply chain. Samsung's memory business revenue increased by 471%, SK Hynix's DRAM average selling price increased by 30% in a quarter, and Gyao's quarterly net profit increased from 183 billion yen to 8422 billion yen, while Ushin's second-quarter net profit increased by 19.87 times, with a gross margin of 51%.

The top-tier companies in the industry chain, including Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, are the main beneficiaries of this round of price increases, and they are further consolidating their control over production capacity and pricing power by shifting their production capacity from low-margin consumer-grade memory to high-margin HBM.

The companies in the middle of the supply chain, including NVIDIA, AMD, and motherboard manufacturers, are enjoying the growth of AI demand, but they are also facing the pressure of rising display memory costs.

On August 1, Gigabyte raised its GPU order prices by 20% to 40%, and AMD increased the prices of its RX 9000 series by 10% to 15%, reflecting the gradual downward transfer of upstream costs to downstream companies.

In the short term, the Chinese domestic supply chain is unlikely to fully fill the gap. Although Chinese AI chips are gradually expanding their applications in government, finance, and other fields, there are still gaps in GPU production capacity, software ecosystems, and developer support in the consumer-grade graphics card and small and medium-sized enterprise markets.
The core supply capacity for advanced memory such as GDDR7 and HBM is still mainly controlled by Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron.
This round of memory price increases is worth noting because the bottleneck in the computing industry is shifting from GPUs to memory.

As GPU computing density continues to improve, the system's performance is no longer determined solely by how fast the chip is, but also by whether the memory can provide sufficient bandwidth to deliver data to the computing unit in real-time.

AI servers are competing for HBM, high-end graphics cards need GDDR7, and smartphones, PCs, and game consoles need DRAM, which may seem like different markets, but they are all competing for limited advanced memory production capacity.

As memory costs rapidly increase, becoming a significant component of the bill of materials (BOM), hardware manufacturers' cost control, supply chain configuration, and product strategies may all be adjusted.

In other words, this round of GPU price increases may seem like a surface-level issue with high-end products like the RTX 5090 and RTX 5080, but the real driver of cost increases is actually shifting from GPUs to memory.
As long as AI data centers continue to absorb advanced memory production capacity, the supply and cost pressures faced by consumer-grade graphics cards will be difficult to quickly alleviate.
This time, the GPU prices have skyrocketed, but the real culprit may not be the most attention-grabbing GPU, but rather the relatively less visible memory.

items.title: 頂尖基金也難跑贏大盤！24大機構「選股」命中率逾半低於50%
items.title_en: Even Top Funds Struggle to Beat the Market: 24 Institutions' 'Stock Picking' Success Rate Below 50%
paras: 就算是全球頂尖的基金經理人，似乎也沒有大家想像中那麼容易「選對股票」；而且選對股票的比例高，亦不代表最後一定能打敗大盤。隨著今年第二季13F申報期限於8月14日截止，追蹤的24家大型機構持倉已全數公開，也讓市場得以檢視這批頂尖投資人究竟有多少資金押對了方向。
一項針對24家機構的持倉統計顯示，若以6月30日至8月14日、共45個交易日為觀察區間，並以同期標普500指數3.96%的漲幅作為基準，24家機構中僅少數投資人的持倉有超過一半資金配置在跑贏大盤的個股上。
其中，Viking Global與淡馬錫以66.7%的「命中率」並列第一，代表兩家機構約三分之二的持倉資金配置在同期表現優於標普500的股票。
選股命中率榜，押中跑贏標普500股票的資金占比：
值得注意的是，即使是量化投資領域的重要代表文藝復興科技，這一期間押注跑贏大盤的資金比例也僅略高於一半；而能夠擠進前10名的最低門檻，更只有48.7%。
從整體樣本來看，24家機構中有15家的命中率低於50%，中位數為44.3%。換言之，在這項特定期間與計算方式下，多數機構配置的資金中，超過一半並未跑贏標普500。
不過，單看「命中率」仍不足以衡量投資績效。
如果將24家機構的持股資金合併計算，涵蓋超過5,000檔股票、總規模逾1.2兆美元，其中52.3%的資金配置在同期跑贏大盤的股票，但這個組合的同期報酬率仍只有3.57%，低於標普500的3.96%。
這反映出，選股勝率與最終投資報酬並非同一回事。即使超過半數資金押中表現優於大盤的股票，只要押錯的部位跌幅較大，或押對的股票漲幅不足，整體績效仍可能落後指數。
對大型機構而言，投資決策也不能單純以個股漲跌判斷。管理數百億甚至上千億美元資產時，還必須考量市場流動性、資金規模及贖回等因素，與一般投資人的操作條件並不相同。
分析指出，這代表這份統計更值得注意的地方，不在於判斷哪家機構「最會選股」，而是顯示即使是全球最受關注的專業投資機構，在45個交易日的短期觀察期間，也很難讓大部分資金穩定跑贏大盤。
此外，13F本身也存在明確限制。申報資料主要反映美股多頭持倉，並未涵蓋空頭、期貨、非美股票及現金部位，因此投資人看到的只是機構投資組合的一部分。
同時，13F反映的是6月30日季末的持倉快照，最晚可至8月14日才完成申報。這代表季末至申報日之間的交易並不會立即反映在這份公開資料中，因此無法單憑13F判斷機構在這段期間是否持續持有相關股票。
另外，這24家機構屬於特定追蹤樣本，並非隨機抽樣，因此相關排名不能直接視為整體機構投資人的普遍表現。
其中，Citadel的數據也有特殊性。按照SEC申報規則，其申報內容包含自家做市業務的庫存，因此與單純以投資為主的避險基金持倉並非完全可比。
至於這份統計尚未揭露的其他面向，還包括完整24家排名、調倉與換手表現，以及專門檢視「賣出」決策的相關排名。此外，進一步將各項排名進行相關性分析後，也發現部分榜單實際上可能反映相近的投資特徵。
因此，13F提供的與其說是一份「投資大師答案卷」，不如說是一張截至特定時間點的持倉截圖。
分析人士指出，從這份資料可以觀察大型機構把資金押在哪裡，但若要判斷其真正的投資能力，仍不能只看單一季度的持倉命中率。
paras_en: Even top fund managers seem to have a hard time 'picking the right stocks,' and a high success rate doesn't necessarily mean they'll beat the market. With the second-quarter 13F filing deadline on August 14, the holdings of 24 major institutions have been disclosed, allowing the market to see how many of these top investors have bet on the right direction.

A study of the 24 institutions' holdings shows that, over the 45 trading days from June 30 to August 14, only a few investors had more than half of their funds allocated to stocks that outperformed the S&P 500.
Viking Global and Temasek tied for first place with a 66.7% 'hit rate,' meaning that about two-thirds of their holdings were in stocks that outperformed the S&P 500 during the period.
The stock-picking hit rate ranking shows the percentage of funds allocated to stocks that outperformed the S&P 500:
Notably, even Renaissance Technologies, a leading quant fund, had a stock-picking success rate of only slightly above 50% during this period.

Looking at the overall sample, 15 of the 24 institutions had a hit rate below 50%, with a median of 44.3%. In other words, most institutions allocated more than half of their funds to stocks that did not outperform the S&P 500 during this period.
However, looking at the 'hit rate' alone is not enough to measure investment performance.

If we combine the holdings of the 24 institutions, covering over 5,000 stocks and a total of over $1.2 trillion, 52.3% of the funds were allocated to stocks that outperformed the S&P 500 during the period, but the combined portfolio's return was only 3.57%, lower than the S&P 500's 3.96%.

This reflects that stock-picking success rate and final investment returns are not the same thing. Even if more than half of the funds were allocated to stocks that outperformed the market, if the wrong stocks fell sharply or the right stocks did not rise enough, the overall performance could still lag the index.

For large institutions, investment decisions cannot be made solely based on individual stock performance. When managing hundreds of billions or even trillions of dollars, they must also consider market liquidity, fund size, and redemption, which are different from the conditions faced by individual investors.

Analysis suggests that this study is more noteworthy for what it shows, not which institution is the 'best stock picker.' It shows that even the most closely watched professional investment institutions have a hard time letting most of their funds consistently outperform the market over a 45-trading-day period.

Additionally, 13F itself has clear limitations. The filing data mainly reflects long positions in US stocks and does not cover short positions, futures, non-US stocks, or cash positions, so investors only see a part of the institution's investment portfolio.

At the same time, 13F reflects the holdings as of the end of the quarter, with the latest filing date on August 14. This means that trades made between the end of the quarter and the filing date are not immediately reflected in this public data, so it is not possible to determine from 13F alone whether the institution continued to hold the relevant stocks during this period.

Furthermore, the 24 institutions in this study are a specific tracking sample and not a random sample, so the rankings cannot be directly taken as a representation of the overall investment performance of all institutions.

Citadel's data also has special characteristics. According to SEC filing rules, its filing includes inventory from its own market-making business, which is not comparable to the holdings of a pure investment-focused hedge fund.

As for the other aspects of this study that have not been disclosed, including the complete ranking of the 24 institutions, the buying and selling activity, and the performance of the 'sell' decisions, as well as further analysis of the correlations between the rankings, it has been found that some of the lists may actually reflect similar investment characteristics.
Therefore, 13F provides a snapshot of the holdings as of a specific time point, rather than a comprehensive 'investment master answer sheet.'

Analysts point out that from this data, we can see where large institutions have placed their bets, but to judge their true investment ability, we cannot rely solely on a single quarter's holding hit rate.

items.title: 輝達砸30億美元押注SB Energy！再提供1000億美元信貸挺OpenAI資料中心
items.title_en: NVIDIA Invests $3 Billion in SB Energy, Provides $100 Billion Credit to OpenAI Data Center
paras: 人工智慧（AI）晶片巨頭輝達(NVDA-US) 持續加碼AI基礎設施投資。根據科技媒體《The Information》報導，輝達正與能源企業SB Energy洽談一筆最高達30億美元的投資，資金主要將用於支持SB Energy在美國俄亥俄州為OpenAI興建的大型資料中心。
報導指出，這筆投資是輝達、OpenAI與SB Energy三方整體合作的一環。
根據目前討論中的方案，若相關項目正式簽約，輝達將先投入預計投資總額的一半、15億美元；剩餘資金則計畫在SB Energy首次公開募股（IPO）時投入。
若交易最終按照現行方案完成，輝達將成為SB Energy此次IPO的主要投資方之一。
SB Energy最快可能在9月掛牌上市，目標募資至少50億美元。不過，目前相關投資仍處於協商階段，最終金額可能調整，交易也不一定能夠落地。
此外，SB Energy也可能延後IPO，以爭取更大的募資規模。
除了直接入股之外，輝達還計畫為俄亥俄州資料中心園區提供約1,000億美元的信貸兜底支持，協助OpenAI取得完成項目所需的融資。
此前已有報導指出，OpenAI將進駐該資料中心，並採用輝達晶片。對輝達而言，透過提供資金支持AI基礎設施建設，也能進一步帶動客戶採購並持續使用其硬體產品。
今年以來，輝達已持續向AI產業鏈不同環節投入資金。近期，公司同意投資德州另一座AI園區的電力基礎設施開發商Lancium 20億美元，並約定後續再追加10億美元。
此外，輝達也分別向雲端服務業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 與Nebius(YNDX-US) 投資20億美元，並向最大晶片客戶OpenAI投資300億美元。
不過，輝達同時提供信貸支持並直接投資客戶的模式，也開始引發部分投資人的疑慮。
部分市場觀點認為，AI生態系對輝達資金的依賴程度正在提高，而「投資客戶、客戶再採購輝達產品」的循環融資模式能否長期維持，仍有待觀察。
一名熟悉相關項目談判的信貸高階主管指出，市場目前對這類直接投資或承銷客戶算力需求的交易，已不像過去那麼普遍受到追捧。另有私人信貸機構對直接向OpenAI提供貸款也抱持審慎態度。
另一方面，根據《華爾街日報》報導，為緩解投資者對公司風險敞口的擔憂，輝達已大幅下調其為OpenAI數據中心提供的擔保金額，修訂後的財務擔保規模從原來的2500億美元降至1200億美元以下。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US), a leading AI chipmaker, continues to invest heavily in AI infrastructure. According to a report by The Information, NVIDIA is in talks with energy company SB Energy to invest up to $3 billion, with the funds primarily used to support SB Energy's large data center in Ohio, USA, for OpenAI.
The report notes that this investment is part of a broader collaboration between NVIDIA, OpenAI, and SB Energy.

Under the current proposal, if the deal is finalized, NVIDIA will initially invest $1.5 billion, half of the total investment amount, and the remaining funds will be invested in SB Energy's initial public offering (IPO).
If the deal is completed as planned, NVIDIA will become one of the main investors in SB Energy's IPO.

SB Energy is expected to go public as early as September, aiming to raise at least $5 billion. However, the investment is still in the negotiation stage, and the final amount may be adjusted, and the deal may not materialize.
In addition, SB Energy may delay its IPO to raise a larger amount of capital.
In addition to direct investment, NVIDIA plans to provide approximately $1 trillion in credit support for the Ohio data center park, helping OpenAI secure the necessary financing for the project.

Earlier reports suggested that OpenAI will occupy the data center and use NVIDIA chips. For NVIDIA, providing financial support for AI infrastructure construction can further drive customer purchases and continued use of its hardware products.

This year, NVIDIA has continued to invest in various segments of the AI industry. Recently, the company agreed to invest $2 billion in Lancium, a developer of power infrastructure for an AI park in Texas, and has committed to an additional $1 billion in subsequent investments.
In addition, NVIDIA has invested $2 billion each in cloud service providers CoreWeave (CRWV-US) and Nebius (YNDX-US), and $30 billion in its largest chip customer, OpenAI.
However, NVIDIA's model of providing credit support and direct investment to customers has raised concerns among some investors.

Some market views believe that the AI ecosystem's dependence on NVIDIA's funding is increasing, and the 'invest in customers, customers repurchase NVIDIA products' cycle financing model may not be sustainable in the long term.

A senior credit executive familiar with the negotiations said that the market is no longer as enthusiastic about direct investments or sales of customer computing needs as it was in the past. Private credit institutions also have a cautious attitude towards providing loans directly to OpenAI.

On the other hand, according to a report by The Wall Street Journal, to alleviate investor concerns about the company's risk exposure, NVIDIA has significantly reduced the collateral amount for its data center for OpenAI, revising the financial collateral scale from the original $25 trillion to below $12 trillion.

items.title: 德儀推首款商用CAN XL收發器 搶人形機器人商機
items.title_en: TI Unveils Industry's First Commercial CAN XL Transceiver for Humanoid Robot Market
paras: 德州儀器(TXN-US)今(17)日推出業界首款商用CAN XL收發器TCAN6062，其控制器區域網路(CAN)擴展資料欄位長度(XL)收發器支援每個訊框最高2,048位元組的有效負載和高達20Mbps的資料速率，同時確保訊息能夠優先且及時送達，滿足人形機器人、工業機器人和人機介面(HMI)系統對性能的需求。
